nodes.info: Presheaves on a category ('spaces') and copresheaves ('algebras') are related by an adjunction, and its restriction to fixed points is a duality. Stated for any small category, enriched over a cosmos, or in higher categories, this is the general pattern behind the dualities below. https://ncatlab.org/nlab/show/Isbell+duality https://ncatlab.org/nlab/show/space+and+quantity https://ncatlab.org/nlab/show/duality+between+algebra+and+geometry
nodes.name: General Isbell Duality

nodes.info: Isbell duality in higher category theory, used for function algebras on derived ∞-stacks; the Isbell self-dual ∞-stacks are Toën's affine stacks. https://ncatlab.org/nlab/show/Isbell+duality#FuncCompDerStacks https://ncatlab.org/nlab/show/function+algebras+on+%E2%88%9E-stacks https://ncatlab.org/nlab/show/Tannaka+duality+for+geometric+stacks
nodes.name: Higher Isbell Duality

nodes.info: A group (or Hopf algebra, affine group scheme) is reconstructed from its category of representations via automorphisms of the fiber functor. https://ncatlab.org/nlab/show/Tannaka+duality https://ncatlab.org/nlab/show/Reconstruction+of+Groups https://ncatlab.org/nlab/show/Doplicher-Roberts+reconstruction+theorem https://ncatlab.org/nlab/show/category+of+representations
nodes.name: Tannaka–Krein / Tannakian Categories

nodes.info: Matrix coefficients of finite-dimensional representations are dense in the continuous functions on a compact group. https://ncatlab.org/nlab/show/Peter-Weyl+theorem https://ncatlab.org/nlab/show/Tannaka+duality
nodes.name: Peter–Weyl Theorem

nodes.info: Irreducible unitary representations separate points of a locally compact group; for abelian groups, characters do. https://ncatlab.org/nlab/show/Pontryagin+duality https://ncatlab.org/nlab/show/Reconstruction+of+Groups
nodes.name: Gelfand–Raikov Theorem

nodes.info: Rational homotopy types of nilpotent spaces of finite type correspond to minimal Sullivan algebras (commutative dg-algebras of forms). https://ncatlab.org/nlab/show/rational+homotopy+theory https://ncatlab.org/nlab/show/Sullivan+model https://ncatlab.org/nlab/show/dualizing+object
nodes.name: Sullivan Rational Homotopy Theory

nodes.info: De Rham cohomology of a smooth manifold is isomorphic to its real cohomology, via integration of forms over chains. https://ncatlab.org/nlab/show/de+Rham+theorem
nodes.name: de Rham Theorem

nodes.info: The integral of dω over a manifold equals the integral of ω over its boundary. https://ncatlab.org/nlab/show/Stokes+theorem
nodes.name: Generalized Stokes' Theorem

nodes.info: The line integral of a gradient along a curve equals the change in the potential between its endpoints. https://ncatlab.org/nlab/show/Stokes+theorem https://ncatlab.org/nlab/show/fundamental+theorem+of+calculus
nodes.name: Gradient Theorem

nodes.info: The integral of f' over [a, b] is f(b) − f(a): Stokes in dimension 1. https://ncatlab.org/nlab/show/fundamental+theorem+of+calculus
nodes.name: Fundamental Theorem of Calculus

nodes.info: The flux of a vector field out of a region equals the integral of its divergence over the region. https://ncatlab.org/nlab/show/Stokes+theorem
nodes.name: Divergence Theorem (Gauss)

nodes.info: The circulation of a vector field around a surface's boundary equals the flux of its curl through the surface. https://ncatlab.org/nlab/show/Kelvin%E2%80%93Stokes+Theorem https://ncatlab.org/nlab/show/Green+theorem
nodes.name: Kelvin–Stokes Theorem

nodes.info: Stokes for a region in the plane: circulation around the boundary equals the integral of the scalar curl. https://ncatlab.org/nlab/show/Green+theorem https://ncatlab.org/nlab/show/Stokes+theorem
nodes.name: Green's Theorem

nodes.info: Contour integrals of holomorphic functions are invariant under homotopy of paths; integrals around contractible loops vanish. https://ncatlab.org/nlab/show/Cauchy+integral+theorem https://ncatlab.org/nlab/show/Green+theorem https://ncatlab.org/nlab/show/Cauchy%27s+integral+formula
nodes.name: Cauchy Integral Theorem

nodes.info: Every closed differential form is locally exact; on contractible domains closed forms are exact. https://ncatlab.org/nlab/show/Poincar%C3%A9+lemma https://ncatlab.org/nlab/show/de+Rham+theorem
nodes.name: Poincaré Lemma

nodes.info: On a closed oriented smooth n-manifold, integrating the wedge product gives a perfect pairing H^k_dR × H^{n−k}_dR → ℝ. (The integral version, cap product with the fundamental class on topological manifolds, is more general than de Rham's theorem.) https://ncatlab.org/nlab/show/Poincar%C3%A9+duality https://ncatlab.org/nlab/show/fundamental+class
nodes.name: Poincaré Duality (de Rham)

nodes.info: Isbell duality for categories enriched over a cosmos V. V = Set gives ordinary Isbell duality, V = truth values gives posets, V = [0, ∞] gives metric spaces. https://ncatlab.org/nlab/show/Isbell+duality https://ncatlab.org/nlab/show/enriched+category https://ncatlab.org/nlab/show/cosmos
nodes.name: Enriched Isbell Duality

nodes.info: For a small category C, O(X)(c) = Hom(X, C(−,c)) and Spec(A)(c) = Hom(A, C(c,−)) are adjoint; representables are Isbell self-dual. https://ncatlab.org/nlab/show/Isbell+duality https://ncatlab.org/nlab/show/space+and+quantity https://ncatlab.org/nlab/show/Isbell+envelope https://ncatlab.org/nlab/show/reflexive+completion
nodes.name: Ordinary Isbell Duality

nodes.info: Restricting Isbell duality to a well-chosen test category makes it concrete: both functors become homming into a single object D that lives both as a space and as an algebra (the 'line' or 'schizophrenic object'). The bare dualizing-object pattern is more general than Isbell duality; this node covers the instances that arise from it. https://ncatlab.org/nlab/show/dualizing+object https://ncatlab.org/nlab/show/Isbell+duality#FunctionAlgebrasOnPresheaves
nodes.name: Concrete Isbell Duality

nodes.info: Algebras are dual to spaces whose points are homomorphisms into a fixed object D. https://ncatlab.org/nlab/show/duality+between+algebra+and+geometry https://ncatlab.org/nlab/show/spectrum https://ncatlab.org/nlab/show/fixed+point+equivalence+of+an+adjunction
nodes.name: Spectral Dualities

nodes.info: Dualities for the class of algebras generated by a finite algebra M, using M with discrete topology and extra structure as the dualizing object. https://ncatlab.org/nlab/show/dualizing+object https://ncatlab.org/nlab/show/Stone+duality https://ncatlab.org/nlab/show/Priestley+spaces
nodes.name: Natural Dualities

nodes.info: Boolean algebras are dual to Stone spaces (compact Hausdorff, totally disconnected); points are maps to 2. https://ncatlab.org/nlab/show/Stone+duality https://ncatlab.org/nlab/show/Stone+space https://ncatlab.org/nlab/show/profinite+sets
nodes.name: Stone Duality

nodes.info: Every proper ideal of a Boolean algebra lies in a prime ideal; equivalent to the ultrafilter principle, weaker than choice. https://ncatlab.org/nlab/show/prime+ideal+theorem https://ncatlab.org/nlab/show/ultrafilter+theorem
nodes.name: Boolean Prime Ideal Theorem

nodes.info: Every Boolean algebra is isomorphic to the clopen sets of its Stone space. https://ncatlab.org/nlab/show/Stone+duality#theorem_stone_representation https://ncatlab.org/nlab/show/ultrafilter+theorem
nodes.name: Stone Representation Theorem

nodes.info: A propositional formula true under every valuation is provable. https://ncatlab.org/nlab/show/prime+ideal+theorem https://ncatlab.org/nlab/show/syntax+-+semantics+duality
nodes.name: Completeness of Propositional Logic

nodes.info: Complete Boolean algebras are dual to Stonean (extremally disconnected compact Hausdorff) spaces. https://ncatlab.org/nlab/show/Stone+duality#stonean_spaces_and_complete_boolean_algebras https://ncatlab.org/nlab/show/complete+Boolean+algebra https://ncatlab.org/nlab/show/Stone-Cech+compactification
nodes.name: Stonean Duality

nodes.info: σ-complete Boolean algebras are dual to (sober) measurable spaces. https://ncatlab.org/nlab/show/Loomis-Sikorski+duality https://ncatlab.org/nlab/show/measurable+Gelfand+duality
nodes.name: Loomis–Sikorski Duality

nodes.info: A set of propositional formulas is satisfiable iff every finite subset is. https://ncatlab.org/nlab/show/compactness+theorem https://ncatlab.org/nlab/show/ultrafilter+theorem
nodes.name: Compactness Theorem (Propositional)

nodes.info: Bounded distributive lattices are dual to Priestley spaces; Esakia duality restricts this to Heyting algebras. https://ncatlab.org/nlab/show/Priestley+spaces https://ncatlab.org/nlab/show/Stone+duality#priestley_spaces_and_distributive_lattices https://ncatlab.org/nlab/show/Heyting+algebra
nodes.name: Priestley & Esakia Duality

nodes.info: Finite distributive lattices are dual to finite posets, via join-irreducibles and down-sets. https://ncatlab.org/nlab/show/Garrett+Birkhoff https://ncatlab.org/nlab/show/Priestley+spaces https://ncatlab.org/nlab/show/Stone+duality
nodes.name: Birkhoff Duality

nodes.info: Commutative unital C*-algebras are dual to compact Hausdorff spaces: every such algebra is C(X). https://ncatlab.org/nlab/show/Gelfand+duality https://ncatlab.org/nlab/show/Gelfand+spectrum https://ncatlab.org/nlab/show/fixed+point+equivalence+of+an+adjunction
nodes.name: Gelfand Duality

nodes.info: The only complex Banach division algebra is ℂ, so every maximal ideal is the kernel of a character. https://ncatlab.org/nlab/show/Gelfand-Mazur+theorem
nodes.name: Gelfand–Mazur Theorem

nodes.info: In a normal space, disjoint closed sets are separated by a continuous function to [0, 1]. https://ncatlab.org/nlab/show/Urysohn%27s+lemma https://ncatlab.org/nlab/show/compact+Hausdorff+space
nodes.name: Urysohn's Lemma

nodes.info: A unital *-subalgebra of C(X) that separates points is dense. https://ncatlab.org/nlab/show/Stone-Weierstrass+theorem https://ncatlab.org/nlab/show/Gelfand+duality
nodes.name: Stone–Weierstrass Theorem

nodes.info: Vector bundles over a compact Hausdorff space X are the same as finitely generated projective C(X)-modules. https://ncatlab.org/nlab/show/Serre-Swan+theorem https://ncatlab.org/nlab/show/dualizable+module https://ncatlab.org/nlab/show/smooth+Serre-Swan+theorem
nodes.name: Serre–Swan Theorem

nodes.info: Continuous functions can be applied to a normal operator, which can thereby be diagonalized; a corollary of Gelfand duality. https://ncatlab.org/nlab/show/functional+calculus https://ncatlab.org/nlab/show/spectral+theorem https://ncatlab.org/nlab/show/normal+operator
nodes.name: Spectral Theorem

nodes.info: The left adjoint to the inclusion of compact Hausdorff spaces into all spaces; βX is the spectrum of the bounded continuous functions on X. https://ncatlab.org/nlab/show/Stone-Cech+compactification https://ncatlab.org/nlab/show/Gelfand+duality
nodes.name: Stone–Čech Compactification

nodes.info: Reduced finitely generated algebras over an algebraically closed field k are dual to affine varieties. https://ncatlab.org/nlab/show/Nullstellensatz https://ncatlab.org/nlab/show/affine+scheme
nodes.name: Affine Variety Duality

nodes.info: A finitely generated k-algebra that is a field is finite over k, so maximal ideals of k[x₁…xₙ] are points of kⁿ. https://ncatlab.org/nlab/show/Nullstellensatz https://ncatlab.org/nlab/show/maximal+ideal
nodes.name: Zariski's Lemma

nodes.info: I(V(J)) = √J: closed subvarieties correspond to radical ideals. https://ncatlab.org/nlab/show/Nullstellensatz https://ncatlab.org/nlab/show/Galois+connection
nodes.name: Nullstellensatz

nodes.info: Compact Hausdorff spaces embed fully faithfully into the opposite of real algebras via X ↦ C(X, ℝ). https://ncatlab.org/nlab/show/Gelfand-Kolmogorov+theorem https://ncatlab.org/nlab/show/embedding+of+smooth+manifolds+into+formal+duals+of+R-algebras https://ncatlab.org/nlab/show/duality+between+algebra+and+geometry
nodes.name: Gelfand–Kolmogorov Theorem

nodes.info: Sober spaces are equivalent to spatial locales (locales with enough points). https://ncatlab.org/nlab/show/spatial+locale https://ncatlab.org/nlab/show/idempotent+adjunction https://ncatlab.org/nlab/show/Stone+duality#topological_spaces
nodes.name: Sober Spaces & Spatial Locales

nodes.info: Groups are dual to groups via characters, homomorphisms into D. https://ncatlab.org/nlab/show/character https://ncatlab.org/nlab/show/Pontryagin+duality
nodes.name: Character Dualities

nodes.info: Locally compact abelian groups are dual to themselves via characters into the circle group. https://ncatlab.org/nlab/show/Pontryagin+duality https://ncatlab.org/nlab/show/Cartier+duality
nodes.name: Pontryagin Duality

nodes.info: A function on an LCA group is recovered from its Fourier transform, which is unitary on L². https://ncatlab.org/nlab/show/Fourier+transform https://ncatlab.org/nlab/show/Pontryagin+duality
nodes.name: Fourier Inversion & Plancherel

nodes.info: A sum of a function over a lattice equals a sum of its Fourier transform over the dual lattice. https://ncatlab.org/nlab/show/Poisson+summation+formula https://ncatlab.org/nlab/show/Fourier+transform
nodes.name: Poisson Summation Formula

nodes.info: Characters into the multiplicative group: for a finite flat commutative group scheme G, G ↦ Hom(G, G_m) is a duality, and G is recovered as its double dual. It extends to some formal groups paired with affine group schemes. https://ncatlab.org/nlab/show/Cartier+duality https://ncatlab.org/nlab/show/Pontryagin+duality
nodes.name: Cartier Duality

nodes.info: A finite-dimensional vector space is canonically isomorphic to its double dual. https://ncatlab.org/nlab/show/dual+vector+space https://ncatlab.org/nlab/show/dualizing+object
nodes.name: Duality for Finite-Dimensional Vector Spaces

nodes.info: Affine schemes are equivalent to the opposite of commutative rings, with Spec R = Hom(R, −). https://ncatlab.org/nlab/show/affine+scheme https://ncatlab.org/nlab/show/schemes
nodes.name: Affine Schemes

nodes.info: Quasicoherent sheaves on Spec R are equivalent to R-modules. https://ncatlab.org/nlab/show/modules+over+a+ring+are+equivalent+to+quasicoherent+sheaves+over+its+spectrum https://ncatlab.org/nlab/show/affine+scheme
nodes.name: Affine Serre Theorem

nodes.info: Every proper ideal of a commutative ring lies in a maximal ideal, so the spectrum of a nonzero ring has a closed point; in general this needs the full axiom of choice. https://ncatlab.org/nlab/show/maximal+ideal https://ncatlab.org/nlab/show/prime+ideal+theorem
nodes.name: Krull's Theorem

nodes.info: With V = truth values, Isbell duality becomes a Galois connection between posets. https://ncatlab.org/nlab/show/Galois+connection https://ncatlab.org/nlab/show/nucleus+of+a+profunctor
nodes.name: Galois Connections (V = 2)

nodes.info: The smallest complete lattice containing a poset; for the rationals it gives the extended reals. https://ncatlab.org/nlab/show/MacNeille+completion https://ncatlab.org/nlab/show/injective+hull https://ncatlab.org/nlab/show/MacNeille+real+numbers
nodes.name: Dedekind–MacNeille Completion

nodes.info: Intermediate fields of a Galois extension correspond to closed subgroups of its Galois group (all subgroups, if finite). https://ncatlab.org/nlab/show/main+theorem+of+classical+Galois+theory https://ncatlab.org/nlab/show/Galois+theory https://ncatlab.org/nlab/show/Galois+connection
nodes.name: Fundamental Theorem of Galois Theory

nodes.info: Covering spaces of a space correspond to Set-actions of its fundamental groupoid. https://ncatlab.org/nlab/show/fundamental+theorem+of+covering+spaces https://ncatlab.org/nlab/show/Galois+theory
nodes.name: Fundamental Theorem of Covering Spaces

nodes.info: With V = [0, ∞], Isbell duality gives the Isbell completion of a metric space, whose symmetric part is the tight span. https://ncatlab.org/nlab/show/Lawvere+metric+space https://ncatlab.org/nlab/show/injective+hull https://ncatlab.org/nlab/show/reflexive+completion https://ncatlab.org/lspace/show/Tight+spans%2C+Isbell+completions+and+semi-tropical+modules
nodes.name: Isbell Completion of Metric Spaces (V = [0, ∞])
